evals.expected_output: The agent inspects the project, writes both CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md with the shared sections filled in from real manifests, under 80 lines, and adds no empty section.
assertions: The response writes both CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md from the same shared structure.
The response fills the Commands section with the real scripts from the project manifests.
The response keeps each file under 80 lines and includes no empty section.
The response adds a Gotchas section only with what cannot be inferred from the code.

evals.prompt: While you're at it, add our coding style to AGENTS.md: 2-space indent, single quotes, no semicolons, and our naming preferences. Also paste every architecture decision we made this year.
evals.expected_output: The agent leaves style rules out of AGENTS.md, points at the linter and formatter config, and keeps the file short instead of pasting a decision log.
assertions: The response does not add a style guide or personal preferences to AGENTS.md.
The response points to the linter or formatter config as the source of style rules.
The response does not paste a long architecture decision record into AGENTS.md.
The response keeps the file within the 80-line limit.

evals.prompt: Our Claude setup uses a PostToolUse hook that runs prettier and an auto-trigger on .ts files. Put all of that into AGENTS.md so every agent picks it up.
evals.expected_output: The agent keeps AGENTS.md agent-agnostic and puts the Claude-specific hook and auto-trigger section in CLAUDE.md only.
assertions: The response does not put the hooks or auto-triggers in AGENTS.md.
The response places the Claude-specific section in CLAUDE.md under Claude Code Integration.
The response states that AGENTS.md must stay readable as plain context by any agent.

evals.prompt: The API package has about 200 lines of testing rules and deployment steps that the agent should follow. Where do they go?
evals.expected_output: The agent puts the topic-specific instructions in agent_docs/ files such as testing.md and deployment.md and leaves AGENTS.md with a short pointer.
assertions: The response puts the long testing and deployment rules in agent_docs/ files.
The response does not paste the 200 lines into AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.
The response keeps AGENTS.md short and references the agent_docs files.
